testsuite.name: run.trama.saga.SagaExecutionProcessorShutdownTest

testcase.name: lost lease releases the claim without failing or acking it()
a failed execution is released, not acked, so its claim can expire and be re-delivered()
a worker exception feeds the rate limiter()
stale checkpoint acks the duplicate copy without failing it()
stop polling drains claimed work before workers exit()
a workflow that ends FAILED is acked and does not feed the rate limiter()
